packs.name: Uncle Energy
packs.blurb: Socks that have opinions about the grill.

packs.name: Gas Station
packs.blurb: Loud little prints from the spinning rack by the register.

packs.name: Fake Merch
packs.blurb: Free socks from events you may or may not have attended.

packs.name: Cursed
packs.blurb: Socks that are a little bit wrong and perfectly nice about it.

packs.name: Impossible Socks
packs.blurb: Three socks that should not exist, kept for the people who kept looking.

heroes.name: Two Stripe Tube
heroes.flavor: Came in a bag of twelve and fits every foot in the family equally badly.

heroes.name: The Grill Master
heroes.flavor: Has never once been inside.

heroes.name: World's Okayest
heroes.flavor: Did its best, and its best was fine.

heroes.name: Lawn Chair Plaid
heroes.flavor: Folds flat for storage and pinches you exactly once a summer.

heroes.name: Bait Shop Shades
heroes.flavor: Camouflaged so well that it has been missing from the drawer since June.

heroes.name: Calf Sock Under Sandals
heroes.flavor: Pulled all the way up, exactly as the sandals intended.

heroes.name: Dad's Golf Diamond
heroes.flavor: Would love to walk you through all eighteen holes, one stroke at a time.

heroes.name: Thanksgiving Tie Print
heroes.flavor: Bought to match the tie, which was bought to get a laugh at dinner.

heroes.name: The Church Sock
heroes.flavor: The good pair, saved for Sundays, weddings and meeting someone's parents.

heroes.name: Bowling Night
heroes.flavor: Bowls a hundred and twelve on a good night and owns the shirt anyway.

heroes.name: Tacos With Faces
heroes.flavor: Each one is having a slightly different day.

heroes.name: Dinosaur on a Lawnmower
heroes.flavor: The lawn has never looked better, and nobody knows whose lawn it is.

heroes.name: Bass in Sunglasses
heroes.flavor: Got thrown back once and has worn these ever since.

heroes.name: Hot Dog Astronaut
heroes.flavor: The first hot dog in orbit, and it is still a little warm.

heroes.name: Cactus Wearing a Hat
heroes.flavor: Keeps the hat on indoors, and nobody has had the heart to mention it.

heroes.name: Raccoon Eating Fries
heroes.flavor: Insists the fries were a gift.

heroes.name: Pickle Party
heroes.flavor: Nobody remembers who invited the pickles, but the party got better.

heroes.name: UFO Abducting a Cow
heroes.flavor: The cow seems oddly calm about the whole thing.

heroes.name: The Flamingo
heroes.flavor: Has been standing on one leg since the store opened.

heroes.name: A Sloth Doing Taxes
heroes.flavor: Filed on time, which surprised everyone, including the sloth.

heroes.name: Tour '94 for Damp Towel
heroes.flavor: The band played eleven towns that summer, and it rained in all of them, which they took personally.

heroes.name: Muncie Comets Tee Ball
heroes.flavor: The Comets went undefeated, mostly because nobody kept score.

heroes.name: Lake Hoyt Regatta
heroes.flavor: Nobody at Lake Hoyt has ever finished the race, but the lunch afterward is excellent.

heroes.name: Family Reunion 2011
heroes.flavor: Aunt Carol ordered ninety pairs for sixty people, so there are still some in her garage.

heroes.name: Vote Bartleby
heroes.flavor: The campaign handed these out to babies, who cannot vote, and the candidate would prefer not to discuss it.

heroes.name: Dave's Reasonable Tires
heroes.flavor: Dave gave these away with every oil change and would like you to know the tires are also reasonable.

heroes.name: Camp Wappalusk Staff
heroes.flavor: Counselors were issued these socks, a whistle, a clipboard, and no further instructions.

heroes.name: The Corn Festival 5K
heroes.flavor: The course is flat and fast, except for the mile that goes through the corn maze.

heroes.name: A Cruise That Was Fine
heroes.flavor: The buffet was fine, the weather was fine, and the slippers from the gift shop are also fine.

heroes.name: Local Band You Missed
heroes.flavor: They played one show in a laundromat, and everyone who was there still talks about it.

heroes.name: The Glove Sock
heroes.flavor: Insists its five toes are fingers and waves every time the dryer opens.

heroes.name: Shoe Pattern Sock
heroes.flavor: From across the room it is a sneaker; up close it is a sock with ambitions.

heroes.name: The Damp One
heroes.flavor: Has been through the dryer eleven times and remains, somehow, a little damp.

heroes.name: Tube Sock With a Zipper
heroes.flavor: Nobody knows what the zipper is for, but it is always a little bit open.

heroes.name: Sock That's Mostly Hole
heroes.flavor: Is still technically a sock, held together by three loyal threads and a lot of sentiment.

heroes.name: Inside Out Permanently
heroes.flavor: Flip it all you like; it has been inside out for years and considers this its good side.

heroes.name: The Too Long One
heroes.flavor: If you pull it all the way up, it simply keeps going.

heroes.name: Someone Else's
heroes.flavor: Nobody in this house is this small, and yet it turns up every single wash.

heroes.name: Slightly Warm Still
heroes.flavor: Came out of the dryer on Tuesday and is, for reasons nobody can explain, still warm.

heroes.name: The Third Sock
heroes.flavor: Came through the back of the dryer, matches nothing, and apologizes for the intrusion.

heroes.name: Somehow Still Clean
heroes.flavor: It has been in every Load for years and has never once needed to be.

heroes.name: The Sock With No Inside
heroes.flavor: You can turn it inside out all afternoon, and it will politely stay exactly the same.

heroes.name: Knitted From a Clear Night
heroes.flavor: Look long enough and its brightest stars make the shape of a sock, which it insists is a coincidence.
